User is preparing a supply order for the Jorton depot.
- Add 120 lanterns, 180 ladders, 220 tarps, 240 cable reels, and 230 toolkits.
- Task: Send meeting notes to Vik, Leon, Suri, Dell, Bram, Rafe, Esme. Send morning notes to Rafe and Greta. Send evening notes to Jonah and Kira. Send evening meeting notes to Cora. Send afternoon meeting notes to Bram.
- People Out: Jonah (Cora), Wren (Una), Hugo (Rafe), Teo (Finn), Esme (Nils). Una, Finn, Nils, Greta out; covered by Mira, Ada, Vik, Una.
- Desk Swaps: Mira/Dell, Vik/Kira, Ines/Mira, Rafe/Opal, Kira/Rafe, Mira/Bram, Jonah/Dell, Bram/Pia, Greta/Nils, Una/Dell, Wren/Mira swapping this week.
- Stand-ups: Morning (harbour room), afternoon (garden studio), evening (library annex).
- Room Availability: Pia asked if library annex is free morning. Teo wants east wing kept clear for visitors. Leon prefers garden studio for reviews. Mira thinks library annex is too cold afternoon. Rafe prefers harbour room for reviews. Bram wants north office kept clear for visitors. Wren wants loading bay kept clear for visitors. Hugo prefers east wing for reviews.
- Cold Rooms: Jonah (garden studio evening), Mira (harbour room morning), Vik (loading bay afternoon), Cora (garden studio afternoon).
- Updates: Rafe/Leon want garden studio/print room clear for visitors. Umbrellas in loading bay, east wing, library annex, print room, harbour room, and garden studio. Print room/east wing/library annex repainting (noise). Working coffee machines: harbour, print room, loading bay, east wing, library annex. Maintenance: Lifts near east wing, loading bay, library annex, north office slow. North office repainting (noise). Rafe out rest of week; Dell covering.
